intuition.title: Study context: Intercalation and water exfoliation
intuition.text: The authors attribute blackening to partial Bi/Ti reduction during n-BuLi intercalation. Water removes lithium as LiOH with hydrogen evolution, separating the perovskite and Bi2O2 layers. The printed reaction is retained as an attributed mechanism, not a newly balanced or quantified gas reaction.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 1, Preparation and exfoliation paragraph

intuition.title: Study context: Separate structural scales
intuition.text: Neutron refinement gives the bulk LiBTO unit cell and atomic positions. AFM measures exfoliated platelets on silicon; HRTEM studies PAA/resin sections. EPD assembles platelets into a much thicker film. These objects and dimensions are not interchangeable.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 1–3, Figures 1–3; SI PDF p. 1–11, Crystallography and film data

intuition.title: Study context: Film assembly
intuition.text: The source deposits BTO from PC or DMF under 12 V for one hour at room temperature without thermal treatment. Approximately 850 nm belongs to the illustrated as-deposited film, whose solvent is not identified. Dense/flat/oriented is the authors’ description; the supplied dark SEM images do not support new contour measurements.
intuition.source_locator: SI PDF p. 2–3, 6, 10–11, EPD and Figure S3

intuition.title: Study context: Properties and outlook
intuition.text: Electrical insulation, ferroelectric memory, diffusion barriers and electron transfer are cited motivations. This paper supplies structural and compositional observations, not new quantitative functional-property tests.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 1, 3, Introduction and conclusion

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
